name: Henderson

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story primary residence with a gray shingle roof and attached garage|A small detached white structure sits to the left of the house|A paved driveway and parking area are located at the front of the lot with one vehicle present|Open green lawn surrounds the house on multiple sides|Sectioned off landscaping areas are on the corners of the rear property|Wooden fencing encloses the rear and side portions of the property|The lot has an irregular shape following the curve of the street.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a white single-story house with a gray roof and attached garage|A paved driveway leads from the street to the garage and parking area|One vehicle is parked in the driveway|Green lawn extends across the front of the property|A small white detached structure is visible near the side of the house|Wooden fencing runs along the perimeter.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side of the white house and attached garage|Green lawn extends along this side of the property's backyard|A small white detached structure is present near the house|Wooden fencing continues along the property line|The paved driveway and vehicle are visible toward the front.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back of the white house with a covered patio or porch area|Large open green lawn fills the backyard|Wooden fencing encloses the rear of the property|Landscaping shrubs and trees are present along each corner of the fence line|The small detached structure is visible near the side of the house.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the white house|Green lawn extends along this side in the front yard and a landscaping area in the backyard|Wooden fencing is present|Street access is visible at the front of the lot.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads directly from the street to the attached garage and front parking area. The driveway and open front yard offer clear space for vehicle approach. A small detached white structure is located near the side of the house. Large open lawn areas surround the residence, particularly in the rear. Wooden fencing encloses the backyard. The property sits on an irregular lot shaped by the curved street, with neighboring residences on multiple sides and a church property nearby.
clarifications: Does the attached garage provide interior access into the house? What is the primary use of the small white detached structure beside the house? Is the rear yard fully enclosed by fencing with no secondary gates? Can emergency vehicles stage effectively in the front driveway given the curved street approach? Are there any side gates that allow access around the house into the backyard?
